title: 1970 Topps Houston Astros Team Records Card #448 MLB
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 1970 Topps baseball card features the Houston Astros team records, with card number 448. It is a part of the base set and has been well-preserved, making it a great addition to any sports trading card collection. The card is from the Major League Baseball (MLB) and was manufactured by Topps. 

The card is a must-have for fans of the Houston Astros and collectors of sports trading cards. It is a valuable piece of memorabilia from the 1970 season and is sure to be a conversation starter. Don't miss out on the opportunity to own this piece of baseball history.
